function.description: Set an alarm at a clock time. If no date is given, the alarm goes off the next time that clock time comes round.

time.description: Clock time in 24-hour HH:MM format, e.g. '07:30'.

date.description: Optional calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: remove_alarm
function.description: Remove an alarm set at a clock time, optionally on a specific date.

time.description: Clock time of the alarm in 24-hour HH:MM format.

date.description: Optional calendar date of the alarm in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: add_list_item
function.description: Add one item to one of the user's lists (shopping, to-do, or packing).

list.description: Which list to add the item to.

function.name: remove_list_item
function.description: Remove one item from one of the user's lists (shopping, to-do, or packing).

list.description: Which list to remove the item from.

function.name: create_reminder
function.description: Create a reminder. Time defaults to 09:00; date defaults to the next time that clock time comes round.

text.description: What the user wants to be reminded about.

time.description: Optional clock time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Defaults to '09:00'.

date.description: Optional calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
